kind: Universal combined SHA512 schedule-and-round AIR witness completeness
formal_claims: Actual round iteration preserves all eight state word bounds;actual H0 and K/default0 satisfy input bounds.
For bounded initial state,valid16-word window,and bounded key stream,the explicit combined trace satisfies actual Combined Air.Holds for all1<=log<=22.
Constructor decoding equals the requested state,window,and key.
All schedule,round-state and scheduled-message consumption bit links are derived;no assumed local AIR satisfaction or link-equality hypotheses.

inputs: maximum state/window and arbitrary bounded keys

limitations: Universal completeness remains to be extended through fixed-constant phases,feed-forward and public binding tables.
The combined table accepts arbitrary bounded keys;standard keys are supplied to this constructor,not fixed by this table.
The log-size theorem is semantic completeness,not a runtime or capacity measurement.
Multiblock and padding checks remain verifier-side composition;no recursive cryptographic proof is produced.
No full NEAR state-transition proof,1Pgas capacity measurement,sub-300KB proof,or128-bit quantum-security proof.
